notes: Focused estimates are medians of two process medians. Full harness estimates are medians of two process averages from rendered Mitata output.
New target solvers have no pre-existing JavaScript baseline.
Numerical accuracy is measured on the stated corpus, not a full-domain guarantee. Encoded errors are reported separately because Rec.2020 magnifies near-zero linear residuals.
Shared Rust corrections are covered by tests and parity; Rust kernel performance was not remeasured in this JavaScript milestone.
No Spectre source copied in step two; factories build on the step-one architecture.

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,shutil,os,sys
p=Path('/tmp/gma-m4-step2');repo=Path('/home/lloydk/work/gma-benchmark');version=sys.argv[1];run=sys.argv[2]
src=p/'before' if version=='before' else repo;dest=p/'full-timed'
if dest.exists():shutil.rmtree(dest)
shutil.copytree(src/'src',dest/'src');shutil.copy2(src/'bench.js',dest/'bench.js');shutil.copy2(repo/'package.json',dest/'package.json')
(dest/'node_modules').symlink_to(repo/'node_modules',target_is_directory=True)
for runtime in ['node','bun']:
 args=['taskset','-c','2',runtime]+(['--expose-gc'] if runtime=='node' else [])+['bench.js','--timing-only']
 with (p/f'full-{version}-{runtime}-{run}.log').open('w') as f:subprocess.run(args,cwd=dest,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env={**os.environ,'NO_COLOR':'1'},check=True)
